notes: Conformance fixtures for scripts/skill-conformance.test.ts — shaped fake values only, never real credentials. Two scenarios cover the key-source branches: (1) paste the key into .env, (2) keep it in the macOS Keychain (the `security find-generic-password` check needs no stub: an unstubbed check passes). Exec stubs answer the three captures: `openssl rand -hex 8` mints the link token, the node `createHash` one-liner derives the line id, and the `ncl groups list` jq `join(", ")` lists the agent groups; the restart and the two ncl wiring runs need no stdout.
